market.question: Will the highest temperature in Karachi be 34°C on May 9?

assessment.reasoning: Karachi May 9 forecast shows highs around 35-36°C (96-97°F). The 34°C bin is 1-2°C below forecast central tendency. Possible if forecast slightly overstates or coastal cooling at Masroor (near coast) drops it a degree, but central case is 35-36°C.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Single-degree bin; coastal vs. inland station variation.
